attempts.errorSummary: Fixed 1 code-defect (duplicate quick-view-add-to-cart-btn testid). Remaining failures are all test-code: the BASELINE_NOISE_PATTERNS regex for the defaultProps warning is missing a space between "release." and "Use", so it never matches the actual console message. This causes assertConsoleErrorBudget() to fail in 7 of 9 tests (E2E-001, E2E-004, E2E-004b, E2E-004c, E2E-005, E2E-007, E2E-008).

bugs.issue: BASELINE_NOISE_PATTERNS[1] regex has `release\.Use` but the actual console message has `release. Use` (with a space before 'Use'). The regex never matches, so all defaultProps warnings leak through assertConsoleErrorBudget() and fail the test.
bugs.fix: Change the regex from `/Warning: %s: Support for defaultProps will be removed from function components in a future major release\.Use JavaScript default parameters instead\.%s PageDesignerProvider/` to `/Warning: %s: Support for defaultProps will be removed from function components in a future major release\. Use JavaScript default parameters instead\.%s PageDesignerProvider/` (add space after `release\.`)

bugs.issue: FIXED: useTagCartButton tagged ALL buttons matching 'add to cart' text with data-testid='quick-view-add-to-cart-btn'. ProductView renders responsive duplicate buttons (mobile + desktop), causing strict mode violation when Playwright resolves the testid to 2 elements.
bugs.fix: Applied: now clears stale testids first, then tags only the FIRST matching button (break after first match).
